text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Approaching the fourth corner!
The Umamusume are making their moves!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'll finish this...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh! What's with this pressure...!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (――Blaze forth! All of my love!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Loves Only You!!
Loves Only You takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (I can definitely feel it...! My running has broken through a barrier...!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: "A-Amazing...! Loves Only You has gotten so much stronger this autumn...!! To think she beat Lucky Lilac!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"If they're coming to the Japan Cup,
the race of the century is gonna get even crazier...!
Whoaa, I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"VICTORY IS HEEERE!!" "Ooooooh!!"
"Too cool ;;;;" "Behold the power of love!"
"8888888" "Her best run ever!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...A loss is a loss.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped, but this time—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Loves-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Miss Lala...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Congrats.
...That really was an amazing run.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
It is all thanks to Lala-san
competing for love with me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Love... huh.
So that's the secret to Loves-chan's strength.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …………Aah, this is no good――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Losing still frustrates the hell out of me, though—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...... Give it your all in the 『Japan Cup』.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just go show 'em with all ya got.
Show 'em that 'I'm the strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I'll carry Lala-san's love with me into the Japan Cup and give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds great.
...It's really reassuring."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You vividly demonstrated
a new level of strength to the racing world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —S-So your next race really will be the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's been a tight schedule, but Trainer and I have been planning this since summer, so I intend to face it in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: With this unprecedented, legendary race ahead, tell us straight up: how are you feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I will show all the racing fans.
Our... love. And just how strong it is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Toward a race destined to become a legend... carrying love with her, she moves forward.
